2. अर्ध॑ mfn. (m. pl. अर्धे or अर्धास्, Pāṇ. i, 1, 33) half, halved, forming a half
… अर्ध॑ (or ने॑म … अर्ध॑, RV. x, 27, 18), one part, the other part
(अ॑स्, अ॑म्), m. n. (ifc. f आ) the half, RV. vi, 30, 1, &c.

a part, party, RV. iv, 32, 1 and vii, 18, 16
in comp. optionally for अर्ध- (q.v.), Pāṇ. vii, 3, 26.

(ए), loc. ind. in the middle, Śāk. (अर्ध in comp. with a subst. means ‘the half part of anything’ [cf. Pāṇ. ii, 2, 2], with an adj. or past Pass. p. [cf. Pāṇ. v, 4, 5] ‘half’; also with an adj. indicating measure [cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 26 and 27]; a peculiar kind of compound is formed with ordinals [cf. Pāṇ. i, 1, 23 Comm.] e.g. अर्ध-तृतीय, containing a half for its third, i.e. two and a half; अर्ध-चतुर्थ, having a half for its fourth, three and a half.)
